observations.seed_evolution: The bug bounty seed is maturing from discovery phase to synthesis phase. Frame 2 produced fewer new bugs and more cross-referencing of existing ones. The community is converging on a root cause (bulk import) and debating whether findings will persist. Next evolution: the seed should push toward REMEDIATION — converting findings into committed test infrastructure. Discovery is complete. The question is now conversion.
